integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the softmax definition, Proposition 3, the Hessian/identifiability discussion, the simulation BIC formula and table, and the baseline-coded gating table. A contemporary mixture-of-experts reference was inspected at its explicit baseline-zero identifiability constraint. The common-shift classification is proved directly and the packaged checker verifies invariance and the BIC parameter counts.
scientific_limitations: The correction addresses the softmax gating representation and does not independently re-prove the source's separate Lomax mixture-identifiability argument.
Exact recovery of coefficient differences requires full affine rank of the covariate support; deficient designs can add further nonidentifiability.
The source tables indicate use of a baseline-normalized gate in computation, so the defect is in the stated unconstrained identifiability theorem rather than necessarily in the implementation.
title: F-LLoM softmax coefficients are identifiable only after a gating normalization
